Успео си! Ретко сам видео човека тако храброг као ти. Заиста морам да кажем да заслужујеш да носиш шиљак. Иди замоли Корнелију да ти украси оклоп.

consistency_issues.en: I am sorry, but you don't have so much money.
variants: Жао ми је, али немате толико новца.
Ок, идемо ... {}! Изгубили сте. Лоша срећа. Још једна утакмица?

consistency_issues.en: What? Whatever that is, it's not a port I sail to. {}?
variants: {} Шта кажете, {yes} или {no}?

Од олује! Шта нас све ово злато оптерећује? Зар не мислите да је то мало ризично са свим овим пиратима около? Можете понети {} са собом, али то је то. Остатак одбаците или {donate} у \з Фонд за сирочад авантуриста, заиста.

consistency_issues.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
variants: Пажљиво прегледаш свитке. То су наређења од Rathleton за амбасадора. Овде нема знакова издаје.
Пажљиво прегледаш свитке. То су наређења од Ратхлетон за амбасадора. Овде нема знакова издаје.

consistency_issues.en: You have found {0}.
variants: Нашли сте {0}.

pl_reference_issues.en: No respawns. Last one standing wins. 15 minutes.

pl_reference_issues.lang: No respawns. Last one standing wins. 15 minutes.

pl_reference_issues.pl: Turniej eliminacyjny w systemie drabinkowym. Wydarzenie specjalne.

pl_reference_issues.en: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...
pl_reference_issues.pl: A więc jednak przyszedłeś/przyszłaś, |PLAYERNAME|. Miałam nadzieję, że nie...
pl_reference_issues.lang: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...

pl_reference_issues.en: I can see in your eyes that you are a honest and friendly person, |PLAYERNAME|. You were patient enough to learn our language and I will grant you a special gift. Will you accept it?
pl_reference_issues.pl: Widzę w twoich oczach, że jesteś uczciwą i przyjazną osobą, |PLAYERNAME|. Miałeś/Miałaś dość cierpliwości, by nauczyć się naszego języka, więc dam ci wyjątkowy dar. Przyjmiesz go?
pl_reference_issues.lang: I can see in your eyes that you are a honest and friendly person, |PLAYERNAME|. You were patient enough to learn our language and I will grant you a special gift. Will you accept it?

pl_reference_issues.en: From now on, you shall be known as |PLAYERNAME|, the wolf girl. You shall be fast and smart as Morgrar, the great white wolf. He shall guide your path.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Od teraz będziesz znana jako |PLAYERNAME|, wilcza dziewczyna. Będziesz szybka i sprytna jak Morgrar, wielki biały wilk. To on poprowadzi twoją ścieżkę.
pl_reference_issues.lang: From now on, you shall be known as |PLAYERNAME|, the wolf girl. You shall be fast and smart as Morgrar, the great white wolf. He shall guide your path.

pl_reference_issues.en: From now on, you shall be known as |PLAYERNAME|, the bear warrior. You shall be strong and proud as Angros, the great dark bear. He shall guide your path.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Od teraz będziesz znany jako |PLAYERNAME|, niedźwiedzi wojownik. Będziesz silny i dumny jak Angros, wielki mroczny niedźwiedź. To on poprowadzi twoją ścieżkę.
pl_reference_issues.lang: From now on, you shall be known as |PLAYERNAME|, the bear warrior. You shall be strong and proud as Angros, the great dark bear. He shall guide your path.

pl_reference_issues.en: Well, basically Spectulus is the only one likeminded so far. In fact, he incited me to work in the field in first place. So here I am! {Disguised} as a chalice.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Cóż, tak naprawdę Spectulus jest jak dotąd jedynym, który myśli podobnie. Właściwie to on skłonił mnie do pracy w terenie. No i jestem! {Disguised} jako kielich.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Well, basically Spectulus is the only one likeminded so far. In fact, he incited me to work in the field in first place. So here I am! {Disguised} as a chalice.

pl_reference_issues.en: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Cóż to takiego? Optycznie upośledzona istota zwana |PLAYERNAME|. Jakie fascynujące!
pl_reference_issues.lang: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!

pl_reference_issues.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
pl_reference_issues.pl: Witaj, witaj, |PLAYERNAME|! Wejdź, obejrzyj i kup! Jestem specjalistą od wszelkiego rodzaju {tools}. Po prostu poproś mnie o {trade}, żeby zobaczyć moje oferty! Możesz też zapytać mnie o ogólne {hints} dotyczące gry...
pl_reference_issues.lang: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...

pl_reference_issues.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
pl_reference_issues.pl: Chodzi o |TIME|. Przykro mi, nie mam zegarków do sprzedania. Chcesz kupić coś innego?
pl_reference_issues.lang: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?

pl_reference_issues.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Och, nasz system kanalizacyjny jest bardzo prymitywny - jest tak prymitywny, że został opanowany przez {rats}. Ale rzeczy, które sprzedaję, są przed nimi bezpieczne. Poproś mnie tylko o {trade}, aby to zobaczyć!
pl_reference_issues.lang: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!

pl_reference_issues.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Och, przykro mi, ale nie zajmuję się bronią. To jest sprawa {Obi's} lub {Lee'Delle's}. Mógłbym zaoferować Ci {wybierać} w zamian za {mały topór}, jeśli przypadkiem go posiadasz.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.

pl_reference_issues.lang: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|, your hair looks great! Who did it for you?

pl_reference_issues.en: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
pl_reference_issues.pl: O, cześć, przystojniaku! Miło cię poznać, |PLAYERNAME|. Chętnie znajdę chwilę, by {chat}.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.

pl_reference_issues.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
pl_reference_issues.pl: Tak? Co mogę dla ciebie zrobić, |PLAYERNAME|? Może sprawy bankowe?
pl_reference_issues.lang: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

pl_reference_issues.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Witaj, młody |PLAYERNAME|! Jeśli jesteś ciężko ranny lub zatruty, mogę cię za darmo {heal}.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.

pl_reference_issues.en: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Żegnaj, |PLAYERNAME|, będę tu, jeśli znów będziesz mnie potrzebować.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.

pl_reference_issues.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Cześć. Jak mogę Ci pomóc |PLAYERNAME|? Jeśli chcesz coś kupić, poproś mnie o {trade}. Mogę również wyjaśnić system {mail}.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.

pl_reference_issues.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Och, wejdź proszę, |PLAYERNAME|. Co mogę dla ciebie zrobić? Jeśli potrzebujesz sprzętu na wyprawę, poproś o {trade}.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.

pl_reference_issues.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Oczywiście, przejrzyj moje towary. {Footballs} trzeba kupić osobno.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.

pl_reference_issues.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Czołem |PLAYERNAME|. Jestem farmerem i kucharzem, może zainteresuje cię {trade} jedzeniem? Możesz też zapytać mnie o ogólne {hints} dotyczące gry.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.

pl_reference_issues.en: Welcome to the Hard Rock Racing Track, |PLAYERNAME|.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Witamy na torze wyścigowym Hard Rock, |PLAYERNAME|.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Welcome to the Hard Rock Racing Track, |PLAYERNAME|.

pl_reference_issues.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
pl_reference_issues.pl: Witaj, witaj, witaj, mała damo |PLAYERNAME|! Co cię {here} sprowadza?
pl_reference_issues.lang: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?

pl_reference_issues.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Witaj, |PLAYERNAME|! Niech ziemia cię chroni na skalistych terenach. Jeśli potrzebujesz {passage}, mogę pomóc.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.

pl_reference_issues.en: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
pl_reference_issues.lang: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?

pl_reference_issues.en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Pozdrowienia, |PLAYERNAME|! Musiałeś sporo podróżować. Zawsze chętnie poznaję nowe rzeczy o Zao.
